goal: Prevent fee-bumped wallet transactions from getting an older locktime than the transaction they replace
Eliminates an on-chain fingerprint identifying Bitcoin Core wallet fee-bumps
agreement: Tested approval after edge cases with reorgs, stale chains, and tests were resolved (molnard, nervana21)
Unresolved feedback requesting logic restructuring and cleaner separation of concerns (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an on-chain privacy leak where replacement locktimes fingerprint wallet software
The issue affects a modest volume of transactions, estimated at a few hundred replacements per week
